title: Type 84 RGB Protocol Passive Research Experiment Plan

experiments.name: Change lighting color
experiments.procedure: In configurator, switch color (e.g., from base to pure red #FF0000 or blue #0000FF), click Apply, call kbSaveRGB('color', 'Color change to #FF0000').
questions_to_answer: Byte offset of R, G, B and their encoding (RGB888, BGR, palette)

experiments.name: Change lighting brightness
experiments.procedure: Adjust brightness slider (e.g., from 100% to 50% or 0%), click Apply, call kbSaveRGB('brightness', 'Brightness 100% -> 50%').
questions_to_answer: Presence of checksum or confirmation bit

experiments.name: Change mode (Static -> other effect)
experiments.procedure: Switch animation mode (e.g., Static -> Breathing / Wave / Ripple), click Apply, call kbSaveRGB('effect', 'Static -> Breathing').
questions_to_answer: Whether packet structure changes across modes

experiments.name: Change effect speed
experiments.procedure: In dynamic mode, change animation speed (e.g., from min to max), click Apply, call kbSaveRGB('speed', 'Speed min -> max').
questions_to_answer: Whether other parameters (effect, brightness, color) are preserved

experiments.name: Individual key color (if supported)
experiments.procedure: In per-key lighting mode (Custom / Per-Key), color a single key (e.g., W to green #00FF00), click Apply, call kbSaveRGB('per_key', 'Per-key W to green').
questions_to_answer: LED addressing format (index 0..83 or row/column based)
Correlation of LED index with physical geometry or electrical matrix
Whether the entire lighting matrix is transmitted or a single-key packet
